definitions.explanation: Thick, muddy waste material, especially the sediment that accumulates in sewage treatment plants, rivers, or industrial processes. Also used for contaminated mud from disasters.

examples.japanese: {汚泥|おでい}を{処理|しょり}する。
{下水|げすい}{処理場|しょりじょう}で{大量|たいりょう}の{汚泥|おでい}が{発生|はっせい}する。
examples.english: A large amount of sludge is produced at the sewage treatment plant.

examples.japanese: {洪水|こうずい}の{後|あと}、{道路|どうろ}に{堆積|たいせき}した{汚泥|おでい}の{撤去|てっきょ}{作業|さぎょう}が{続|つづ}いている。
examples.english: After the flood, work to remove the sludge deposited on the roads continues.

notes:
Composed of {汚|お} (dirty, polluted) and {泥|でい} (mud). A technical term commonly found in environmental, civil engineering, and disaster-related contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {汚泥|おでい}の{処理|しょり} (sludge treatment)
- {汚泥|おでい}を{除去|じょきょ}する (to remove sludge)
- {汚泥|おでい}の{撤去|てっきょ} (sludge removal)
- {下水|げすい}{汚泥|おでい} (sewage sludge)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {汚泥|おでい}: sludge (technical, environmental)
- {泥|どろ}: mud (everyday)
- {ヘドロ|へどろ}: slimy sediment, ooze (colloquial, often foul-smelling)
